items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: So I said, 'You couldn't be looking very hard. He lives out here and he's in the union book.'

ctx.x: -- and characters hang out. So I, nonchalant, you know, I says, 'Melrose in town?' He says, 'No.' He says, 'He's retired.' I said, 'Well, who he sold to?' He said, 'Oh, to a lot of different publishers.' So I said, 'Who handles Muskrat Ramble?' So they said, 'John Levy handles that.' I said, 'Yeah?' I said, 'Well, where is he?' They told me the floor. So I said, 'Thanks.' So I take Ory, I said, 'C'mon, let's go.' We go to the floor, the secretary or whatever greets us. So I says, 'Mr. Levy in?' She says, 'Yes.'…
$8,500. Now, you know if he gave him a check for 8,500, what happened to the rest of it, you know. But that was 8,500 Ory didn't have. So --
